reviewerMethod: Codex page-by-page visual review of the 12-page reproduction scan using the repository-local chapter-ingestion and PDF workflows, followed by manifest, source-hash, schema, reference and rubric-total checks

scope.strategy: Exercise-exclusive and reproduction-only: each active prompt comes from a relevant printed exercise item; no prose-only drill questions were added.
scope.included: Sexual reproduction, reproductive structures needed for reproduction, pollination, fertilisation, fruit and seed formation, seed structure and types, and germination.
scope.excludedEarlierPortion: Items testing calyx/corolla, complete/incomplete flowers, bisexual/unisexual classification and monoecious/dioecious plants were excluded unless a reproductive structure was directly needed for pollination or fertilisation.
scope.visualAdaptation: The printed flower case study and art exercise were adapted into one reproduction-only source group with five numbered callouts and three follow-up questions.

excludedByScope.reason: Tests the earlier flower-structure portion only.
Tests the earlier flower-classification portion only.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise III.1: cross, self, water and wind pollination odd-one-out
excludedByScope.reason: No unique odd item is deterministically supported because the list mixes two classification schemes.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise V.5-V.6: complete and bisexual flower definitions
excludedByScope.reason: Tests the earlier flower-classification portion only.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise VII.4: fertilisation, embryo, zygote, seedling, germination sequence
excludedByScope.reason: The supplied reproduction section does not state the zygote-to-embryo sequence, so a fully grounded answer cannot be scored.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise VIII.11-VIII.12: draw hypogeal and epigeal stages
excludedByScope.reason: Freehand drawing is not supported by the current player; the descriptive comparison and process questions are included.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise X.3: mustard as an incomplete flower
excludedByScope.reason: Tests the earlier complete/incomplete-flower portion and is not supported by the supplied reproduction pages.

excludedByScope.item: Exercise XII: nursery visit and planting activity
excludedByScope.reason: Requires external inquiry and a physical activity.
Tests bisexual/unisexual, complete/incomplete, monoecious/dioecious or non-reproductive whorl content from the earlier portion.

sourceAssetReadiness.note: The original, label-free SVG is available at the runtime asset reference, but q-053 remains in review because source_group is stored by the contract and not yet playable.

advisoryNotes: No printed learning-outcomes panel is present in the supplied reproduction-only scan; no outcome wording was invented.
Metadata was inferred from the visible chapter numbering and matching ICSE Class 6 Concise Biology references.
The copyrighted source PDF remains local and is intentionally excluded from Git.
The bank is intentionally moderate in size and follows the relevant printed exercises rather than exhaustively turning every paragraph into new questions.
Questions q-002 and q-014 intentionally retain the same fact in multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank forms because both are separate printed exercise items.
Question q-031 represents the exercise's post-fertilisation terms as two grounded branches because they do not form one scientifically valid linear sequence.
The source-group diagram question is review-only until the player supports that question type.
